expected_value_creation: Make cross-judge dependence, agreement, dissent, abstention, evidence state, and panel-level correlation risk explicit and deterministically reproducible before consensus is trusted.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, accountable policy owners, affected stakeholders, and independent human or AI reviewers
supporting_evidence: Anthropic recommends calibrated model graders and warns that shared infrastructure can create correlated failures.
OpenAI requires evaluation claims to expose harness, inference budget, setup, and validity checks because reward hacking and configuration alter conclusions.
NIST statistical guidance treats intra-cluster correlation as material to evidence interpretation.
success_criteria: Every cross-judge panel links judgments to dependency profiles and exactly reproduces verdict groups, majority state, dissent, and shared dependency dimensions.
Dependent consensus, unverified profiles, and insufficient panel evidence trigger governance without becoming truth, quality, competence, selection, authorization, or authority.
